description: Make a normal map for an image asset, for 2D lights in a game engine: which way each pixel faces, so a moving light shades it. The shape comes from a depth model, the drawn detail from the picture. PNG at the picture's own size, OpenGL style (green = up: Godot and Unity read it as is; flip green for Unreal). Pass frameId (from get_asset) for an edit, or an animation (one map per frame); leave it out for the image itself. Free.

frameId.description: Optional: the frame (an edit or an animation, from get_asset) to make it for. Empty = the image itself.

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

name: make_normal_map
